topic: AI fuels more than half of cybercrime in Africa as scams surge – Interpol
headline: AI's Dark Side in Africa
caption:
As a full stack engineer, it’s eye-opening to see how AI is being exploited to fuel cybercrimes across Africa. From sophisticated scams to identity theft, AI's rapid advancement is a double-edged sword. We need to prioritize ethical AI development and stronger cybersecurity measures to combat these threats. It's a reminder that as tech creators, we must stay vigilant and responsible. Always question how technologies are used and push for transparency. Stay safe online and keep innovating responsibly! 💻🔐
